title: Two Sforza letters, 4 May 1446: Maino reply and Amidani companion
credit: Transcribed by George Lasry with CTTS (CrypTool Transcriber and Solver), who also generated the initial key; the key and reading were improved by Astra and Fable 5.1.

documents.title: Reply concerning Zorzo del Maino’s report

segments.text: tocha ad nuy cerchare questo, ma solum[ente] cerchamo con l'onor de dio
gli havemo rechiesto siano contenti farghi
quello e dicto, et ad quello se refferemo
voglia essere contento mettere per scripto
se tra loro no gli sera noma uno che no habia

documents.title: Companion letter catalogued as Vincenzo Amidani to Francesco Sforza
